_meta.source_request: Founder refinement: no false promises or aspirational claims without substance; hyperscaler-grade/production-ready/mechanically-enforced claims need evidence specs befitting the claim.

description: Seed claim/evidence map for Phase 0. This is not a readiness claim: it prevents empty promises by labeling current regulated language as target/spec/enforced/production/hyperscaler tiers and by identifying the evidence still required before stronger claims are allowed.

gate_contract.producer: GitHub Actions .github/workflows/oya-ci-required.yml fan-in over Rust/Buck2 gate packets; owned oya-ci runner only after explicit proven cutover
reds_when: regulated vocabulary appears in authoritative ADR/spec/plan/operating-contract text without a claim row
the row's claim tier lacks the evidence required by /specs/hyperscaler-production-readiness-claim-contract.json
advisory/local/legacy oya output is presented as mechanical enforcement
production-ready or hyperscaler-grade is asserted program-wide rather than per service/plane
retired/done/superseded is claimed while untracked live references remain

known_gaps_before_green: Seed rows are not exhaustive; the claim-ceiling gate must discover and require rows for all regulated terms in authoritative artifacts.
No production_ready or hyperscaler_grade claim is currently allowed for the program as a whole.

The exact oya-ci-required cutover is verified. Mechanical-enforcement/P0-green remains disallowed because trusted producer/candidate isolation, F-PR5-06 review authority, enforce-admin/signature drift, override, structured-result, and tenant-isolation gaps remain.

seed_claim_rows.allowed_language_now: verified required-context-cutover evidence plus explicit remaining-gap language only
seed_claim_rows.claim_text: required-context cutover verified; Phase-0 mechanical enforcement not green
current_evidence: specs/phase0-ci-enforcement-baseline.json records required_context CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE for exactly oya-ci-required
Live dev protection and current origin/dev workflow receipt prove the exact context is required and green
Trusted-producer isolation, F-PR5-06 review admission, enforce-admin/signature parity, override, structured-result, and tenant-isolation rows remain GAP
missing_for_next_tier: candidate-independent trusted producer and gate catalog
live enforce_admins/signature parity plus drift enforcement
trusted blocking review admission with reviewer distinct from author
known BAD/GOOD fixtures pass through protected admission

seed_claim_rows.allowed_language_now: retired from protected CI authority; residual local-surface retirement remains open
seed_claim_rows.claim_text: oya CLI retired from CI authority
current_evidence: dev requires only oya-ci-required; no oya CLI status is merge authority
automation ratchet blocks mapping new blocking invariants to oya CLI commands
ADR-0363 and docs/AGENTS.md retain residual CLI surfaces as retirement debt/local feedback only
missing_for_next_tier: complete retired-surface and canonical-reference scanner coverage for all residual oya CLI entrypoints

seed_claim_rows.allowed_language_now: contracted/target/gap-packet only until tenant negative tests run under required cloud-ci context
seed_claim_rows.claim_text: internal and tenant pipelines are isolated, secure, and separate
current_evidence: tenant isolation contract and BAD fixture requirements specified
T0.0 requires tenant-pipeline isolation baseline before enforcement claims
missing_for_next_tier: tenant A/B negative tests green in cloud-ci

seed_claim_rows.allowed_language_now: future/reference ownership only; no live Tide claim
seed_claim_rows.claim_text: Tide is a future/reference admission-controller shape; GitHub protected PRs remain current authority
current_evidence: ADR-0515 makes GitHub Actions plus protected GitHub PRs the current authority
No live Tide producer, projected-state, batch, or auto-rebase evidence is attached

seed_claim_rows.allowed_language_now: target/spec-ready only; no production-ready or hyperscaler-grade performance claim without measured service evidence
seed_claim_rows.claim_text: performance/capacity readiness is a target until per-service budgets and measured results exist
current_evidence: claim ceiling blocks advisory benchmarks as authority
